# rizzstack

> rizzstack is a software development factory: coding agents ("bees") work in sandboxes on leased files, and contracts plus test evidence decide what ships. Six repos: workflow (method + protocol), hyvv (worker host, /v1 API), bundlebees (coordinator Hermes plugin), orbitdesktop (operator workspace), orbit-control-plane (dashboard + live observability), uirizz (A2UI cards in Hermes chat).

## Code map
- [L0 overview](https://github.com/mojomast/rizzstack/blob/main/codemap/README.md): one-screen map of the four layers, pins, the core flow and first rules
- [Cross-repo contracts](https://github.com/mojomast/rizzstack/blob/main/codemap/contracts.md): every API, schema id and vendored package, with source of truth and consumers
- [Change recipes](https://github.com/mojomast/rizzstack/blob/main/codemap/change-recipes.md): what to touch, in order, for common cross-repo changes
- [Invariants and approval gates](https://github.com/mojomast/rizzstack/blob/main/codemap/invariants.md)
- [Architecture views](https://github.com/mojomast/rizzstack/blob/main/codemap/architecture.md): context, containers, flows
- [Machine index](https://github.com/mojomast/rizzstack/blob/main/codemap/generated/index.json): JSON summary of all repos
